activator.description: Use a custom activator to trigger the DatePicker

type.name: ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | ((props: DatePickerActivatorProps) => ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<...>>)

firstDayOfWeek.description:
Sets which day is considered the first day of the week.
0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, etc.

fullWidth.description: Whether the datepicker should take up a whole block

highlightDates.description: Dates on the calendar to highlight

inline.description: Determines if the DatePicker should be shown without needing to trigger the Activator.

onChange.description: Change handler that will return the date selected.

onMonthChange.description: Change handler when the selected month changes

onOpenChange.description: Callback when the calendar open state changes

readonly.description: Whether or not you can select a date

smartAutofocus.description:
Determines if the focus moves to the selected date (if any) or back to
the activator
